Miho Arakawa (Japanese: 荒川美穂 Arakawa Miho) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Arakawa was born on December 4, 1987, in , , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined during , where her only role was Concordia, one of 's foster sisters. Arakawa was affiliated with the .
